subject: Request: temporary modification to P1/P2 response windows during scheduled maintenance
messages:
From: James Carter <james.carter@finedge.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: support@redwood.com, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finedge.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary change to P1/P2 response windows for weekend maintenance

Hi Soojin,

We have three weekends of major database maintenance scheduled: Mar 6-7, Mar 13-14, and Mar 20-21. During the maintenance windows (2200–0400 PT) we'll be running rolling restarts of our traffic cluster which may cause elevated latency and short-lived failures.

Given that, FinEdge is requesting a limited SLA exception for P2 (standard: 4h) to allow a 6h response window during those overnight windows, and for P1 we want clarity on the on-call escalation path if an incident correlates with our maintenance.

Can Redwood sign off on a temporary exception tied to those dates and the following constraints:
- exception covers only impacts caused directly by our maintenance activities
- automatic failover to backup region is not considered a Redwood outage unless it materially impacts request success
- we need an explicit escalation contact (phone) for P1s during 2300–0300 PT

I've attached our maintenance calendar and a short summary. Please let us know what you need from our side.

Thanks,
James
James Carter
Head of Platform
FinEdge

Attachment: FinEdge-maintenance-calendar.ics (referenced)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: James Carter <james.carter@finedge.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finedge.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary change to P1/P2 response windows for weekend maintenance

Thanks for the heads-up, James — I appreciate the detailed window and constraints.

Quick summary of what I need to triage internally so we can provide a formal exception:
- exact maintenance windows per weekend (you sent calendar, thanks)
- whether FinEdge expects us to suppress alerts tied to your maintenance or if you prefer those to still generate incidents and be triaged as usual
- confirmation you accept our standard mitigation conditions (canary routing, short failover windows)

I'm looping in Dylan (on-call/platform) for a technical impact assessment and Evelyn for commercial approval of a temporary SLA amendment. Attached is Redwood's SLA-exception-form; please fill in the points highlighted and return it so Legal/Support can route for signature.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) Dylan to confirm whether the on-call rota can provide a phone escalation 2300–0300 PT for the three weekends OR propose an alternate (scripted escalations to phone).
2) We draft a time-limited exception document (to be signed) that enumerates root-cause attribution rules and the explicit date range.
3) If approved, we record the exception in SUP-4821 and link the DocuSign envelope.

I'll aim to provide a redline within 48 hours once Dylan confirms coverage.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Support
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLA-exception-form.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, James Carter <james.carter@finedge.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary change to P1/P2 response windows for weekend maintenance

On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 09:50 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'm looping in Dylan (on-call/platform) for a technical impact assessment and Evelyn for commercial approval...

Hi all — quick technical assessment below. TL;DR: we can support a P2 window extension to 6h limited to your maintenance windows with the following mitigations; P1 commitments should remain the same but require an explicit phone escalation chain during 2300–0300 PT.

Technical notes:
- Root-cause attribution: Distinguishing maintenance-caused errors vs unrelated infra incidents will rely on your maintenance tags and the timing of elevated error-rate spikes. We recommend you post a maintenance tag to the request headers (x-finedge-maintenance: true) during the window to help our triage automation.
- On-call coverage: The current weekend rota is limited; we can offer phone escalation provided we adjust the handover process. I attached a concise handover checklist and proposed automated pager-to-phone escalation rule (15 min escalation to phone for P1s during the maintenance window).
- Fallbacks: We will not treat brief, application-driven failovers during your tests as an outage unless end-to-end success rate drops below 95% for longer than 15 minutes across affected zones.

Operational mitigations I propose:
1) Ask FinEdge to set maintenance header or tag (developer action)
2) Configure automatic incident suppression for alerts directly correlated to that header, with a separate suppressed-incident queue monitored by a single on-call person
3) Pager->SMS->Phone escalation for P1 during 2300–0300 PT (15/10/5 minute steps)

Attachment: handover-checklist.xlsx

If Legal needs stricter language around attribution we can add sample log/trace thresholds.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: James Carter <james.carter@finedge.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finedge.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary change to P1/P2 response windows for weekend maintenance

James — thanks, Dylan — very helpful. Below is the draft exception text we'll use for the signature path. Please review and confirm you accept these bullets; once confirmed I'll route to Legal/Contracts for a DocuSign.

Draft (summary):
- Scope: Temporary SLA exception for FinEdge maintenance windows on Mar 6-7, Mar 13-14, Mar 20-21, 2200–0400 PT.
- Duration: Limited to the dates above; automatically expires 48h after the last maintenance date.
- P2: Response window extended from 4 hours to 6 hours during the maintenance windows only; normal P2 applies outside those windows.
- P1: No change to target response time; however, Redwood will enable an explicit phone escalation to the on-call responder for 2300–0300 PT during maintenance.
- Attribution: Incidents will be considered maintenance-related if the FinEdge maintenance header or tag is present in request traces and the elevated error/latency correlates with your declared window. If not, normal SLA adjudication applies.
- Mitigations: FinEdge to add maintenance header; Redwood will enable suppressed-incident queue and pager->phone escalation as documented.
- Exclusions: Any incident caused by third-party providers or unrelated Redwood infra (outside your maintenance activity) will be adjudicated under standard SLA terms.

If that text looks good, please sign the attached SLA-exception-form and return. Once returned we will: create SUP-4821 (tracking), produce DocuSign, and enable the handover automation.

Soojin

> On Tue, Mar 2, 2027 at 10:40, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Attachment: handover-checklist.xlsx

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: James Carter <james.carter@finedge.com>, Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@finedge.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary change to P1/P2 response windows for weekend maintenance

Soojin / Dylan — reviewed. Thanks for the clear draft. Evelyn here: approved with the following edits and conditions before Legal routes DocuSign:
1) Add a narrow definition for "maintenance-related" with sample trace threshold (>=5% error uplift sustained for >10 minutes) so there's a measurable adjudication criteria.
2) FinEdge must confirm they will include the maintenance header for all test traffic; without that we cannot accept blanket coverage.
3) We will limit the phone escalation to two named Redwood on-call engineers per weekend (Dylan and backup) to control exposure.

Once James confirms the header plan and signs the SLA-exception-form, Contracts will issue DocuSign and we will enable the automation for SUP-4821.

Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
